definitions.gloss: freshly fried; just out of the fryer
definitions.explanation: food that has just been deep-fried and is still hot and crispy

examples.japanese: {揚|あ}げ{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧だ。
examples.english: Freshly fried tempura is the best.

examples.japanese: {揚|あ}げ{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{揚|あ}げ{立|た}てな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧です⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: This croquette is fresh from the fryer, so the inside is hot.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧ (to deep-fry) + ⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (just done)

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ~⟦{立|た}て→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ pattern indicates something freshly done:
- ⟦{焼|や}き{立|た}て→焼き立て：08344_yakitate⟧ - freshly baked
- ⟦{茹|ゆ}で{立|た}て→茹で立て：08483_yudetate⟧ - freshly boiled
- ⟦{出来立|できた}て→出来立て：08343_dekitate⟧ - freshly made
- ⟦{採|と}れ{立|た}て→採れ立て：08484_toretate⟧ - freshly picked

USAGE:
- Often used in food service to emphasize quality
- Used as a no-adjective: {揚|あ}げ{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧

RELATED WORDS:
- サクサク - crispy (onomatopoeia)
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ{物|もの}→揚げ物：04975_agemono⟧ - fried food
- ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧ - oil
